paragraphs: NJBSoft sells SAMS, a platform the homepage presents as Compliance Software Management for utilities. Modules include stormwater inspection and MS4 compliance software for SWPPP management, BMP tracking, mobile field audits, and annual report generation.

SAMS integrates field, process, and lab data in a secure, centralized system, where entries are audit-ready and historical records are preserved. The platform also tracks metrics, generates reports such as DMRs and MORs, and configures custom alerts.

Customer stories on the homepage name the City of Phoenix, where NJBSoft is described as helping streamline municipal workflows. A second story names the City of Peoria. The homepage groups its audience by role, naming compliance managers, operators, executives, and field teams.

quote.text: Unify your data, strengthen operations, and protect public trust
